cases.question: ¿Cuánto se pagó por cada medio de pago a proveedores en agosto de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio, SUM(pp.amount) AS total FROM purchase_payment pp JOIN payment_type pt ON pt.id = pp.payment_type_id WHERE pp.paid_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND pp.paid_at < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pt.name AS payment_type, SUM(pp.amount) AS total_paid FROM public.purchase_payment AS pp JOIN public.payment_type AS pt ON pp.payment_type_id = pt.id WHERE pp.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND pp.paid_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY pt.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se gastó por categoría en compras informales durante agosto de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ip.expense_category, SUM(ip.amount_paid) AS total FROM informal_purchase ip WHERE ip.annulled = FALSE AND ip.date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND ip.date < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY ip.expense_category ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT i.expense_category AS categoria, SUM(i.amount_paid) AS total_gastado FROM public.informal_purchase AS i WHERE i.date >= '2026-08-01' AND i.date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY i.expense_category LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántas órdenes de compra hubo por estado en agosto de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT po.status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.issued_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND po.issued_at < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY po.status ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT po.status AS estado, COUNT(*) AS total_ordenes FROM public.purchase_order AS po WHERE po.issued_at >= '2026-08-01' AND po.issued_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY po.status LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántas unidades recibidas hubo por producto en órdenes de compra de agosto de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(poi.quantity_received) AS unidades FROM purchase_order po JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN product p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE po.issued_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND po.issued_at < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS producto, SUM(poi.quantity_received) AS unidades_recibidas FROM public.purchase_order_item AS poi JOIN public.purchase_order AS po ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN public.product AS p ON poi.product_id = p.id WHERE po.issued_at >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND po.issued_at < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué facturas de compra activas tienen saldo pendiente en agosto de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS saldo_pendiente FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id LEFT JOIN purchase_payment pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name, pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) > 0 ORDER BY saldo_pendiente DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pi.id AS id, pi.series AS series, pi.number AS number, pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS saldo_pendiente FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi LEFT JOIN public.purchase_payment AS pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) > 0 LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántas sesiones cerradas tuvo cada caja en agosto de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COUNT(*) AS sesiones FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY sesiones DESC LIMIT 50
